title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2u0i: fragile u8 cast in multi_fragment_single_window test payload range
description: In rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs:53, the payload is built via `(0..(TILE_SIZE + 7) as u8).map(|i| i as u8).collect()`. The `as u8` on the range upper bound silently truncates if TILE_SIZE + 7 > 255 (e.g. if TILE_SIZE ever grows past 248), turning a range into a wrong smaller range. The `.map(|i| i as u8)` is also a no-op since `i` is already `u8`. Fix: use `(0usize..TILE_SIZE + 7).map(|i| i as u8).collect()` to avoid the truncation hazard and the redundant cast.
